plot: At dawn in the pantry a second Pim appears and both swear they are real; the handshake test makes the real, extra-scared Pim look guilty and the spider test makes both faint, until Crispy points out every sneeze happened next to the calm 'Pim One', Lolly flips him over and he is Shaker, a pepper-shaker spy for the appliances in a bean costume, who escapes and drops a three-eyed note naming Pim as the next target.

script.title: Which Pim Is the Fake One

beats.say: AAAH! There are two of me! Which one of us is fake?!
Him! He's the fake! I'm the real Pim! Look at my bandage!
Identical bandage. Identical shaking. Ah... ah... ACHOO!
Bless you! Okay. Nobody move. One of you is a stranger.
A stranger with my face! Do I really look this shaky?
Simple. Zeek, label them. Pim One and Pim Two.
Zeek slaps a sticker on each bean. One. Two. They both scream.
I'm Pim One! One is the best number! The realest number!
N-no! I'm the real one! I've been scared since breakfast!
Test one. Our secret handshake. Both of you, show me.
Pim One does it perfectly. Pim Two slaps his own face.
I forgot! I'm too scared to remember where my hands are!
Suspicious, Pim Two. Very, very suspicious.
Pim One, come here, sweetie. A welcome hug. Ah... ACHOO!
Sneeze number two. My nose would like to file a complaint.
It's just pantry dust! Very dusty pantry! Nothing to see!
Careful. Pick the wrong bean, and our Pim stays here forever.
Then pick me! Pim Two can't even say Bup's name right!
I can! It's... Bop. Bep. B-B-Bup! See? Bup!
They're both shaking! This whole test is useless!
Test two. Pim fears everything. So I present: a spider!
It's a raisin with eight licorice legs. Both Pims faint.
Great. Two fainted Pims. Worst morning of my whole life.
Well, they faint the same way. Face first. Very dramatic.
Okay, I'm up! Totally normal Pim here. Let's go home, friends!
No! He woke up too fast! The real me stays fainted longer!
He has a point. That's the most Pim sentence ever spoken.
Or it's exactly what a clever fake would say! I can't tell!
Sunlight creeps under the door. It only opens once each morning.
We take one Pim home. Choose wrong, and we lose ours forever!
I've been watching. Every sneeze happened next to the same bean.
Pim One! Both sneezes! Nobody ever sneezes near the real Pim!
Pim One. Sweetie. Why do you smell like PEPPER?
Pepper? Me? I'm a bean! Beans smell like... bean stuff!
Wrong answer.
Lolly flips him upside down. Black pepper pours out of his head.
He's a pepper shaker in a bean costume! That's MY bandage!
I knew it. Real Pim never lies. He's too scared to.
Fine! I'm Shaker! Spy for the appliances! You all sneeze funny!
Shaker hops up the shelves like a tiny salty rocket.
Pim Two. You were the real Pim the whole time.
I told you! Nobody is better at being scared than me!
Then here's your prize. A real hug. Zero sneezing.
Lesson learned. Never trust a bean who isn't scared.
And next time, Pim gets a name tag. Permanent marker.
He dropped something. A note with three eyes stamped on it.
Next target? Target for WHAT?!
